citation_prompt_metric: Index valid and source text prefix present in actual rendered/truncated request; semantic support is separately judged
citation_structural_metric: Numeric[n]/【n】 within actual returned source indices; not semantic truth
percentile: Linear interpolation over all500 successful final attempt latencies; not a load-test/SLA claim
reference_retrieval_proxy: Silver reference chunk IDs, not exhaustive Gold relevance; alternate valid evidence can exist
retry_latency: Final successful attempt timings used for successful E2E; per-attempt failures and retry counts separately retained
success_definition: Nonempty real chat completion through production entry, complete trace, hybrid mode, no generation fallback or cross-encoder
trace_latency: Production trace latency excludes final PostgreSQL log append; reported separately
unanswerable_diagnosis: No-answer score<1 with faithful answer and no hallucination flag goes to uncertain, never treated as confirmed hallucination solely due to unverified label
wall_latency: per-case request after processor initialization; includes budget observation, raw response persistence and production logging; no model cold initialization included
